texts.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
texts.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, which turns [From.GetName]'s own gravity against it.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Lensing built

notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Matter Decompressor fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order.

texts.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
texts.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Boring built

texts.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
texts.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

label.en: After the next upgrade: Extraction completed

texts.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
texts.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decanted into an unending fleet of robotic barges to be delivered around our empire.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个黑洞的名称。
note.en: In the game, the black hole's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“物质解压器”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
texts.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional, some mechanism preventing its spaghettification must still be operational.

texts.zh: 位于[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]事件视界上的是一个“物质解压器”——一个从黑洞中获取矿物的巨型结构。即使机能不全，它的引力扭曲引擎一定仍在运作，否则它早就因为黑洞的引力变成一团意大利面条了。
texts.en: Perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is a "Matter Decompressor" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional,  its gravitational twist engine must still be operational as it has not suffered spaghettification.

label.zh: 它似乎与我们自己的很像。
label.en: It seems similar to our own.

label.zh: 修复废墟（建造“修复”型巨型结构）后

notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

texts.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，物质解压器：锚定细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
texts.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the Matter Decompressor: Anchor sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]'s event horizon.

summary.text:
# 物质解压器 / Matter Decompressor

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/06_matter_decompressor.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Megacorp（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工物质解压器（见 common/megastructures/06_matter_decompressor.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Matter Decompressor inside your borders (common/megastructures/06_matter_decompressor.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. mega.9010：锚定阶段建成 / Anchor built
2. mega.9011：透镜阶段建成 / Lensing built
3. mega.9012：钻探阶段建成 / Boring built
4. mega.9013：萃取阶段完工 / Extraction completed

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- 无（该巨型结构不向其他帝国发送专门通知）/ none (this megastructure sends no dedicated notices to other empires)
- 废墟 The ruin：mega.9100（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_matter_decompressor_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；mega.9101 在修复完成后出现。
  mega.9100 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). mega.9101 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.


## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/06_matter_decompressor.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
